positive_snippets: We had an extremely comfortable 15 days stay at Hotel Goel Residency. The room was clean with all the amenities which were well functioning. The owner is a sweet natured, humble lady. Her team of support staff is well trained and cooperative.The Hotel is strategically located next to the Metro station,affordable eateries and market places. Highly recommend this place for a comfortable stay.

I had a comfortable stay at Hotel Goel Residency. The rooms were clean and well-maintained, the service was prompt and professional, and the location was very convenient. It was a great experience overall.
negative_snippets:
Very disappointing stay. Worst experience ever.
Zero if possible

The condition of the room was extremely pathetic and not at all worth the money charged. The owner, Mrs. Geol, charged three times more than the amount shown on online booking platforms. Since my check-in and check-out timings were odd, I reluctantly accepted the amount, but I deeply regret that decision.

There was no proper service or attendance. I had to wait at the reception for nearly 30 minutes with no staff available. Basic amenities were missing—no toiletries were provided, which is unacceptable.

The behaviour may appear polite, but the service is extremely poor and totally unprofessional. Overall, this has been the worst hotel stay of my life.

I would never recommend this hotel to anyone

The worst experience I have ever had at Goel Residency

This was truly the most unpleasant stay my family has ever experienced. We chose Goel Residency because it was listed as a family stay, but the behaviour of the old lady managing the place was shockingly rude, disrespectful, and completely lacking in basic hospitality. Instead of offering help or courtesy her attitude made my parents feel unwelcome, uncomfortable, and stressed throughout their stay. I was in a different city at the time. I deeply regret trusting this place with their comfort and safety.

Her tone, behaviour, and overall manner were so unprofessional. No guest, especially elderly parents, should have to deal with such negativity from someone who is supposed to manage the place.

This was an awful experience, and I would strongly advise others to avoid booking here if they expect even the minimum level of respect and hospitality. Never ever book this place.

My parents checked in at 10:30 AM, and I had requested a 4-hour extension, which clearly allowed them to stay until 2:30 PM. Yet the staff at Hotel Goel—especially the old lady—insisted they leave by 12 or 12:30. She then became rude and arrogant, repeatedly telling my parents to check out.

On the other hand, I paid you ₹1500 an amount that should cover a full day’s stay, not just 2 or 4 hours.
